   - **痛点 C（`PSS 7` 抽纸盒 `B0821LD25K`，NCX 12.5% *极差*）**：
     - 8 单退了 1 单，买家拿普通非风琴便签塞进 Pop-up 盒子里说 *"Post-its do not pop up properly"* —— 需要在副图强调 **必须配合 Accordion / Pop-up Z-fold（如 `30315` 风琴便签）使用**。

sha = hashlib.sha256(open(out_work, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
print(f"Batch 18 built & copied to Desktop! Rows={len(rows_to_write)}, SHA256={sha}")
for a in audit_list:
    print(" ", a)

{"Content":"import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageOps, ImageFilter

out_dir = r"D:\4A\00_当前工作区_202611\voc_infographics"
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

def get_font(size, bold=True):
    candidates = [
        r"C:\Windows\Fonts\arialbd.ttf" if bold else r"C:\Windows\Fonts\arial.ttf",
        r"C:\Windows\Fonts\segoeuib.ttf" if bold else r"C:\Windows\Fonts\segoeui.ttf",
        r"C:\Windows\Fonts\calibrib.ttf" if bold else r"C:\Windows\Fonts\calibri.ttf",
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if os.path.exists(c):
            return ImageFont.truetype(c, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, box, radius, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. FULL ADHESIVE: HOW TO PEEL FLAT (NO CURLING / NO TEARING) - 2000x2000
# ==============================================================================
canvas1 = Image.new("RGB", (2000, 2000), (248, 250, 252))
draw1 = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas1)

# Top Header Banner
draw_rounded_rect(draw1, (40, 40, 1960, 250), 28, fill=(15, 23, 42))
draw1.text((1000, 110), "HOW TO PEEL FLAT WITHOUT CURLING", font=get_font(68, True), fill=(255, 255, 255), anchor="mm")
draw1.text((1000, 195), "90% Full Adhesive Back + 10% Bottom Non-Stick Grip Edge", font=get_font(40, False), fill=(253, 224, 71), anchor="mm")

# Left Card: Product Anatomy (702877118504.pt01.jpg + 305-FULL-GLUE-8.jpg)
draw_rounded_rect(draw1, (40, 290, 980, 1460), 28, fill=(255, 255, 255), outline=(203, 213, 225), width=4)
draw_rounded_rect(draw1, (40, 290, 980, 390), 28, fill=(30, 64, 175))
draw1.text((510, 340), "1. FIND THE NON-STICK GRIP EDGE", font=get_font(40, True), fill=(255, 255, 255), anchor="mm")

img_pt01 = Image.open(r"D:\4A\印刷用图片\电商\亚马逊图片-2018\6-----4A Full Adhesive Notes\302-FULL GLUE\702877118504.pt01.jpg").convert("RGB")
img_pt01.thumbnail((860, 580), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
canvas1.paste(img_pt01, (510 - img_pt01.width // 2, 420))

img_strip = Image.open(r"D:\4A\印刷用图片\电商\亚马逊图片-2018\6-----4A Full Adhesive Notes\305-FULL GLUE\305-FULL-GLUE-8.jpg").convert("RGB")
img_strip.thumbnail((880, 240), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
canvas1.paste(img_strip, (510 - img_strip.width // 2, 1030))

# Callout box inside Left Card
draw_rounded_rect(draw1, (70, 1260, 950, 1430), 18, fill=(239, 246, 255), outline=(59, 130, 246), width=3)
draw1.text((510, 1310), "NOTE: Dashed Line is on Top Cover Sheet Only!", font=get_font(34, True), fill=(30, 58, 138), anchor="mm")
draw1.text((510, 1365), "All inner sheets are 100% blank & unperforated.", font=get_font(30, False), fill=(30, 64, 175), anchor="mm")
draw1.text((510, 1405), "The bottom strip below the line is glue-free for easy gripping.", font=get_font(27, False), fill=(51, 65, 85), anchor="mm")

# Right Card: Side-to-Side Peel Action (702877118559.pt06.jpg)
draw_rounded_rect(draw1, (1020, 290, 1960, 1460), 28, fill=(255, 255, 255), outline=(22, 163, 74), width=5)
draw_rounded_rect(draw1, (1020, 290, 1960, 390), 28, fill=(22, 163, 74))
draw1.text((1490, 340), "2. PEEL SIDE-TO-SIDE (HORIZONTALLY)", font=get_font(38, True), fill=(255, 255, 255), anchor="mm")

img_pt06 = Image.open(r"D:\4A\印刷用图片\电商\亚马逊图片-2018\6-----4A Full Adhesive Notes\305-FULL GLUE\702877118559.pt06.jpg").convert("RGB")
img_pt06.thumbnail((840, 760), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
canvas1.paste(img_pt06, (1490 - img_pt06.width // 2, 420))

# Draw horizontal arrow overlay on img_pt06 showing peel direction
arrow_y = 960
draw_rounded_rect(draw1, (1120, arrow_y - 38, 1860, arrow_y + 38), 38, fill=(22, 163, 74))
draw1.text((1490, arrow_y), "PEEL HORIZONTALLY ALONG EDGE  --->", font=get_font(34, True), fill=(255, 255, 255), anchor="mm")

# Green DO vs Red DON'T inside Right Card
draw_rounded_rect(draw1, (1050, 1210, 1930, 1320), 16, fill=(240, 253, 244), outline=(22, 163, 74), width=3)
draw1.text((1490, 1250), "CORRECT: Peel Side-to-Side from Non-Stick Corner", font=get_font(32, True), fill=(21, 128, 61), anchor="mm")
draw1.text((1490, 1292), "Sheet stays 100% flat & adheres flush to walls, monitors & paper.", font=get_font(27, False), fill=(22, 101, 52), anchor="mm")

{"Content":"import os
import shutil

import openpyxl
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

out_dir = r"D:\4A\00_当前工作区_202611\voc_infographics"

    for c in candidates:

draw0.text((1595, 303), "REAL PAD DESIGN", font=get_font(38, True), fill=(255, 255, 255), anchor="mm")

img_pt01 = Image.open(r"D:\4A\印刷用图片\电商\亚马逊图片-2018\6-----4A Full Adhesive Notes\302-FULL GLUE\702877118504.pt01.jpg").convert("RGB")
img_pt01.thumbnail((680, 560), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
canvas0.paste(img_pt01, (1595 - img_pt01.width // 2, 380))

img_strip = Image.open(r"D:\4A\印刷用图片\电商\亚马逊图片-2018\6-----4A Full Adhesive Notes\305-FULL GLUE\305-FULL-GLUE-8.jpg").convert("RGB")
img_strip.thumbnail((680, 220), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

for idx, (title, desc, col, bg) in enumerate(surfaces):

# Now update Batch 19 to include:
# - 4A 0166 (Row 7): Color (58) = 'White-atlantic Ocean', Color Map (254) = None, Package units (380,382,384) = 'Inches', Col 10 (Item Highlight) = None
# - 4A 039, 4A 040, 4A 037, 4A 60238, 4A SF-60238: keep their exact unlocked Colors + clear Col 10 (Item Highlight, 0-based index 10 = Excel Col K!)
# - All 15 VOC SKUs: also clear Col 10 (Item Highlight, 0-based index 10 = Excel Col K)

from build_batch19_voc_fixes import updates_by_sku, cat_by_sku, h4, tpl_path, out_xlsm, audit_json

        "reason": "Final 8541 color match on 4A 0166 (549 FBA units, B0784GHSVJ): set Color='White-atlantic Ocean' + Package Units='Inches' + clear Col K Item Highlight",

    },
    "4A 039": {
        "reason": "Clear Col K (index 10) Item Highlight on 4A 039 while preserving unlocked Color='Orange&pink' and Manufacturer='4A'",
        "cols": {10: None, 54: "4A", 58: "Orange&pink", 254: "Orange"},
    },
    "4A 040": {
        "reason": "Clear Col K (index 10) Item Highlight on 4A 040 while preserving unlocked Color='Red&pink' and Manufacturer='4A'",
        "cols": {10: None, 54: "4A", 58: "Red&pink", 254: "Red"},

    "4A 037": {
        "reason": "Clear Col K (index 10) Item Highlight on 4A 037 while preserving unlocked Color='Green&yellow' and Manufacturer='4A'",

    "4A 60238": {
        "reason": "Clear Col K (index 10) Item Highlight on 4A 60238 while preserving unlocked Color='Colors-60238' and Manufacturer='4A'",
        "cols": {10: None, 54: "4A", 58: "Colors-60238", 254: "Multicolor"},
    },
    "4A SF-60238": {
        "reason": "Clear Col K (index 10) Item Highlight on 4A SF-60238 while preserving unlocked Color='Colors-60238' and Manufacturer='4A'",
        "cols": {10: None, 54: "4A", 58: "Colors-60238", 254: "Multicolor"},
    },
}

combined_updates = {}
combined_updates.update(extra_batch18_clean)
for k, v in updates_by_sku.items():
    v["cols"][10] = None  # Excel Col K is 0-based index 10!
    combined_updates[k] = v

wb_out = openpyxl.load_workbook(tpl_path, keep_vba=True)
ws_out = wb_out["Template"]
if ws_out.max_row > 7:
    ws_out.delete_rows(8, ws_out.max_row - 7)

audit_records = []
row_idx = 7
for sku, spec in combined_updates.items():
    base_row = list(cat_by_sku[sku])
    diffs = {}
    base_row[4] = "Edit (Partial Update)"
    for c_idx, new_val in spec["cols"].items():
        old_val = base_row[c_idx]
        base_row[c_idx] = new_val
        diffs[f"Col_{c_idx}_{h4[c_idx]}"] = {"old": old_val, "new": new_val}
    for c_idx, val in enumerate(base_row, 1):
        ws_out.cell(row=row_idx, column=c_idx, value=val)
    audit_records.append({
        "row": row_idx,
        "sku": sku,
        "asin": base_row[12],
        "reason": spec["reason"],
        "changes": diffs,
    })
    row_idx += 1

wb_out.save(out_xlsm)
shutil.copy2(out_xlsm, r"E:\Desktop\19-voc-copy-and-pack-clarity-fixes.xlsm")
sha256_val = hashlib.sha256(open(out_xlsm, "rb").read()).hexdigest()

with open(audit_json, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

print(f"Updated {out_xlsm} | Rows={len(audit_records)} | SHA256={sha256_val}")
